raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 CRM migration, migrated customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so these codes pass straight into silver_customers and break gold_region_daily. raw_region_map (4 unique codes) gives the documented translation: 01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
